_help: Copy of the quality check settings. baseline: the old code (a commit, branch or tag; HEAD is the last commit). candidate: the new code (working = this folder as it is now, or a commit). model_profile: which model to use (its id or name; empty = the one selected in the app, else the first ready one). seeds: every case runs once per seed on both sides. live: false runs only the audit (no model). judge.mode: manual (you review in the report), llm (the model in judge.config judges blind; same model as the run = a hint only) or off. Each case is builder (idea) or dataset (subject). Optional per case: target, director (id), length, creativity, style, capture, aspect (dataset ratio, such as 3:4), mode (builder), rules, amount, nsfw, triggers, vocabulary_packs, inputs (dataset).

cases.idea: an old fisherman mending a net at dawn

cases.subject: two dancers rehearse a lift in an empty studio
three friends share a secret at a campfire
